Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is sent by the trading Member as the initial message used to establish a trading session. It is also used to re-establish a session after a break.

Field.Name: protocolVersion
Field.Description: Version of the protocol being used

Field.Name: senderID
Field.Description: Value as agreed with Aquis to identify the Member’s ATP session

Field.Name: password
Field.Description: Password as agreed with Aquis to verify the user

Field.Name: inactivityTimeout
Field.Description: Optional inactivity timeout, in seconds. If there are no messages received for this period of time then Aquis will close the session (triggering cancel on disconnect)

Field.Name: atpSeqNo
Field.Description: The next sequence number that the trading Member is expecting to receive on messages from Aquis

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by Aquis to acknowledge a Login request, and either accept or reject it.

Field.Name: resultCode
Field.Description: Set to 0 for successful login. Rejection codes are: 1 = Already Logged In, 2 = Sequence Number Error, 3 = Unsupported Protocol, 4 = Failed Authentication (incorrect password), 5 = Unknown Source Network

Field.Name: clientSeqNo
Field.Description: Next sequence number Aquis expects to receive

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: A Heartbeat message is simply a message header with msgType is set to 0 and msgSeqNo set to the sequence number that will be sent on the next business message.

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: The Logout Request message is used by the trading Member to request the closure of a trading session.

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: The Logout message is usually sent as a response to the Logout Request. However it may also be sent by Aquis in case of a low sequence number or other protocol violation, or for other reasons. The TCP/IP connection is closed immediately after this message has been sent.

Field.Name: logoutReasonCode
Field.Description: Reason code for logout 0 = User Requested, 1 = Admin (Market Operations), 2 = Disconnect, 3 = End of Day, 4 = Inactivity Timeout, 5 = Protocol Error, 6 = Sequence Number Error

Field.Name: reasonText
Field.Description: Text describing reason for logout

Message.Name: Order Add Message
Message.Description: The Order Add message is sent by the trading Member to enter an order for a particular security.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric security identifier

Field.Name: orderType
Field.Description: 1 = Limit Order, 2 = Auction on Demand (Limit Order), 3 = Auction on Demand (Mid Pegged/Limit), 4 = Auction on Demand (Near Touch Pegged), 6 = Market at Close, 8 = Post-Only Cancel Replace (POCR), 9 = Post-Only (PO), 10 = Restricted POCR Order*, 11 = Restricted Post Only Order*. *with optional IOC/FOK

Field.Description: 1 = Day order, 2 = Fill or Kill (FOK), 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC), 9 = Good For Auction (GFA). Only Day orders are valid for the Market at Close (MaC). GFA orders are only valid for the Auction on Demand (AoD). IOC orders will be treated as Accept-Or-Cancel for ordertype = 2 or 3.

Field.Name: side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy Order, 2 = Sell Order

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order 0 for MaC orders.

Field.Name: orderCapacity
Field.Description: 1 = AOTC (A), 2 = DEAL (P), 3 = MTCH (R)

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier 1 = House Account, 2 or above = ID for an agreed Client Account code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: Flags
Field.Description: Order flags

Field.Description: Bit 7-4= PartyRoleQualifier 0 – None, 1 – Algo, 2 – Firm, 3 – Person Bit 3-0= PartyRole 0 – None, 1 – ClientID, 2 – Executing Decision ID, 3 – Investing Decision ID
